messages:
zoe (pm): Handoff into ENG: lifecycle playbook MVP for model onboarding -> deprecation. Goal: concrete, implementable scope for catalog-facing APIs, pin TTL defaults, canary rollout flow, and benchmark acceptance criteria. Need engineering scope + owners by Thu EOD.

mike (eng): Quick Q: do we own autoscaler / Dedicated routing here or just the catalog & rollout policy config?

zoe (pm): Just catalog + rollout policy surface (pin/unpin API, canary cohorts, migration plan). Autoscaling/Dedicated ops handled separately — we'll provide hooks.

alice (eng-ml): For benchmarks propose: p50/p95 generation latency, tokens/sec throughput for 8/16/32 seq lengths, and a quality regression guard: eval-suite pass rate >= 98% vs baseline. Suggest storing standard eval prompts per model.

ben (product-eng): Pin TTL proposal: default 90 days with auto-notify at 30/10/3 days. Exceptions: enterprise customers can request 1yr opt-out via contract. We should add a per-tenant "pin-exemption" flag. Thoughts?

carla (cs): We need a templated migration comms pack (email + in-console banner + migration guide). Customers will ask for a gracepath checklist: export configs, canary opt-in, and rollback steps.

sam (devex): I can ship a quickstart and example config for canary + pin TTL. Example config snippet:```json
{"canary": {"cohorts": ["5%", "20%"], "duration_days": 3}, "pin_defaults": {"ttl_days": 90, "notify_days": [30,10,3]}}
```I'll add to docs repo.

mike (eng): Implementation notes from infra side: need endpoints: POST /pins, GET /pins/:tenant, PATCH /pins/:id (extend/expire), and a background job that emits notifications and triggers rollouts. Also need a compatibility shim for older model aliases.

zoe (pm): Good callouts. Owners + rough ETA: Mike -> API + background job (PR by Tue), Alice -> eval-suite and benchmark harness (initial dataset by Wed), Sam -> quickstart + docs (Wed), Ben -> policy + contract exceptions doc (Thu). Carla -> customer comms template (Thu). I'll collect these into the playbook doc. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Reminder: created playbook draft in #product-docs at https://redwood.example/s/playbooks/lifecycle-mvp (auto-link)
thread_summary: PM hands off lifecycle playbook MVP; discussions on scope (catalog vs autoscaler), benchmarks (latency, throughput, eval-suite), pin TTL defaults (90d), canary config example, API endpoints needed, owners + deadlines set for early-week PRs and docs.
